answer: To neutralize Sybil attacks, an AI agent network uses stake-bonded graph validation. Each agent locks collateral inside a smart contract vault to emit an authenticated identity signal. Unverified nodes lacking capital or peer trust are isolated on a restricted execution island, completely excluded from consensus scoring. To deploy fake identities, an attacker must continuously lock substantial capital per node, turning Sybil creation into a strictly linear, economically prohibitive endeavor.
